_about: Hand-checked corrections to the state status table ('Where each state stands'). Each entry replaces the language model's cell for that state and marker. Fields: status (done | announced | none), text, date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), document (the government's own page or file), source (a report, when there is no official page), checked (the date someone confirmed the link and the text). Markers: ai_policy, ai_body, funding, infrastructure. Applied by pipeline/profiles.py apply_curated.
